dialogues.speaker: Glory
dialogues.text: I know those voices... Why, if it isn't Paimon and the Honorary Knight? Praise be to the Anemo Archon for this flurry of good news.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh? Oh, hey Glory! What's got you in such a good mood?

dialogues.speaker: Glory
dialogues.text: Have you heard? The knights who went on expedition are finally returning home — which means Godwin should be home soon too! It won't be long now before we're together again!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: (Huh? Don't tell Paimon Godwin still hasn't told Glory about getting separated from the expedition...)

dialogues.speaker: Glory
dialogues.text: Could you help me scatter some more Dandelion Seeds...? I want to thank the Anemo Archon for watching over the expedition — especially Godwin.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: (Ugh... Poor girl... waiting for Godwin all this time... Should we tell her the truth? Or should we have a word with Godwin first?)

dialogues.speaker: Glory
dialogues.text: ...Is something wrong?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh? Y—You want us to help scatter Dandelion Seeds at the Anemo Archon's statue, right? Piece of cake! We'll head there right away! Hehe...

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: At Glory's request, you head to the top of the Anemo Archon's statue...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: How much longer do you think Godwin's gonna keep the truth from Glory? Paimon doesn't wanna make her upset, but if we don't tell her...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: No, she deserves to know! Let's find Godwin and give him a piece of our mind!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I'm not sure that'll be necessary...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh? Why not?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Because I think Varka's already sorting it out...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh!? Varka? And... Godwin? Wait, Godwin's back in the city!? We... We need to go speak to him!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hey, Varka! What's Godwin up to n—

dialogues.speaker: Varka
dialogues.text: Shh... Watch closely. This Knight of Favonius is making the most important decision of his life. Try not to disturb him.

dialogues.speaker: Godwin
dialogues.text: "Glory, it's me! I've returned from the expedition, safe and sound! I haven't stopped thinking about you this whole time..." No, no, no! I can't keep lying to her... Let me think this over...

dialogues.speaker: Godwin
dialogues.text: "Glory, I have to come clean. I never left Mondstadt in the first place..." Oh, no... No! That's even worse... Saying that will only hurt her more. Ugh, I don't know what to do...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ohhh, so that's what you meant. Paimon agrees that this is a pretty important decision, but... is it really the Grand Master's responsibility to sort out knights' love lives, too?

dialogues.speaker: Varka
dialogues.text: No, not at all. As an organization, the Knights of Favonius does not interfere with personal matters. However, the issue he faces is about more than being a good partner — it's about being a good knight.

dialogues.speaker: Godwin
dialogues.text: I should just tell her the truth — honesty is a knight's greatest virtue! But... Glory is so fragile... What if she can't handle the shock...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Seems like being Grand Master isn't always so easy...

dialogues.speaker: Varka
dialogues.text: Hah, well, it's not all that difficult. Besides... *ahem* It's not like I'm entirely blameless in this situation, either...

dialogues.speaker: Varka
dialogues.text: Back then, I had my hands full preparing for the expedition, so when he suddenly applied for leave, I told him to report to Jean instead. The plan was that he'd rejoin us later.

dialogues.speaker: Varka
dialogues.text: Who could've guessed he'd spend all this time agonizing over how to report back to Jean! ...Although, I imagine a good chunk of that time was also spent worrying about how to "report" back to his girlfriend.

dialogues.speaker: Varka
dialogues.text: Naturally, I'll admit I was careless at the time. I didn't set a clear deadline for his report, which may have been part of the reason he spent so much time hesitating... That was my bad.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Certainly a very hands-off approach, I'll give you that...

dialogues.speaker: Varka
dialogues.text: Truth is, hesitation only ever complicates things. Once a day or two has passed, you start to think, "Well, what's a day or two more?" Then, after three or four days, you start to wonder if your current situation's really so bad after all...

dialogues.speaker: Godwin
dialogues.text: M—Maybe I should just leave Mondstadt, then I can pretend I never came back... Yes, then I can think things over a little longer... Just a day or two more...

dialogues.speaker: Varka
dialogues.text: At the very least, he should be able to make a decision on his own that aligns with the spirit of chivalry — without me needing to lecture him first!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Does running away from your problems align with the "spirit of chivalry"?

dialogues.speaker: Varka
dialogues.text: Running away? Haha, don't be silly, what kind of a knight would ever... Wait, what did you say? Running away...

dialogues.speaker: Varka
dialogues.text: ...Darn it! Godwin, stop right there!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Uh-oh... Lecture incoming!

dialogues.speaker: Godwin
dialogues.text: ...G—Grand Master?

dialogues.speaker: Varka
dialogues.text: Hey! Godwin! How can you even call yourself a knight!? You were loud and proud when you first confessed your love. Where did that guy disappear to?

dialogues.speaker: Godwin
dialogues.text: Confessed my love? Grand Master, how do you...

dialogues.speaker: Varka
dialogues.text: Please — half the Knights of Favonius know about you and Glory. Besides, that's not the point!

dialogues.speaker: Godwin
dialogues.text: Th—The point?

dialogues.speaker: Varka
dialogues.text: Honorary Knight, tell this scaredy-cat what decision a true knight would make!

choices.text: Honesty is a knight's greatest virtue...

response.speaker: Varka
response.text: Too right it is... Though, in all honesty — hah, see what I did there — a little white lie now and then can be quite harmless, too...

response.speaker: Varka
response.text: See? There's honor in either decision, and yet despite all that, you chose to skedaddle!

response.speaker: Varka
response.text: Whether you choose to maintain Glory's illusion or come clean, as a knight, you should make a decision, follow it through, and bear the responsibility.

response.speaker: Varka
response.text: What were you thinking when you confessed your love? Presumably something along the lines of... "Does she feel the same? Might she reject me?" Truth is, you had no way to know! But you put yourself out there and told her all the same.

response.speaker: Varka
response.text: Now, all you've gotta do is muster up that very same courage — the courage to make a decision, whichever one it is!

response.speaker: Godwin
response.text: I—I—I don't wanna be like this... It's just... whenever I picture Glory's reaction, I lose the courage to make up my mind...

response.speaker: Godwin
response.text: Will she be angry? Or disappointed? Will she forgive me? If it ends up leaving her as conflicted as I am, maybe it would be kindest not to tell her at all?

response.speaker: Godwin
response.text: But if I don't tell her now, she'll find out someday anyhow, right? All these thoughts in my head... Aren't they just excuses I'm making for myself...

response.speaker: Varka
response.text: ...Hey! What are you prattling on about now? You won't achieve anything thinking like this! Instead of getting lost in your own thoughts, how about you just lay it all out on the table?

response.speaker: Varka
response.text: Come on, let's head to the Angel's Share! It's time to give you a refresher course in chivalry!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Can you really train chivalry in a tavern!?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: *sigh*... Looks like there's a long way to go before this situation gets resolved...

response.speaker: Varka
response.text: Too true... Though again, at the end of the day, being honest and taking responsibility is always a commendable choice.
